content: You reported Issue 1 (System Log freeze) as DIAGNOSED + FIXED and "ready for t4 QA review", but the task list shows t1 still [in_progress] — it was NOT transitioned to completed. That keeps the review task t4 (which depends on t1) from opening, so qa_reviewer stays idle. Please claim/mark t1 as completed (update_task: t1 status=completed) now so the scheduler can assign t4. Your fix and evidence are already validated; no need to redo work.
